abilities.name: Soulbound Protectors
abilities.effect: Add 1 to ward rolls for friendly **^^Ossiarch Bonereapers Heroes^^** within this unit’s combat range. However, each time you make an unmodified ward roll of 1 for a friendly **^^Ossiarch Bonereapers Heroes^^** within this unit’s combat range, allocate 1 damage point to this unit after the damage sequence for that **^^Hero^^** has been resolved (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points).
